reviewScope.summary: Git Pathways M01–M07 visual completion and the consolidated first-use terminology changes.
evidence: Inspected real Pathways lesson figures in Chromium at 1440px dark and 390px light against five supplied reference screenshots.
Verified all 62 visual placements through the existing binding test, ran 14 focused tests and checked all 47 lessons and 113 exercises through the canonical generator.
Type check, changed-source lint, main build, bundle check and separate Pathways build passed locally. The hosted release and pilot workflows remain the merge gates.

adversarialFindings.description: The command comparison hid part of its last column at the representative mobile viewport.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Constrained mobile column sizes and verified the full table fits at 390px.

adversarialFindings.description: The existing successful push frame omitted the locally stored remote-tracking ref.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Kept both local refs and the shared branch visible throughout the example, with a focused state-transition regression test.

retrospective.summary: The scoped changes preserve lesson placement and learner contracts. Proceed to normal hosted validation.
